- Achieve quarterly revenue targets through the acquisition of new accounts within your assigned territory.
- Identify, develop, and qualify leads; self-sourcing efforts will be supplemented by regional support from Marketing, Inside Sales, and Channel teams.
- Present and demonstrate Darktrace cyber threat defense solutions to information security experts and C-level executives.
- Partner closely with Darktrace Subject Matter Experts, Technical Account Managers and Cyber Threat Analysts who will support you in delivering Proof of Values (POVs) to prospective customers.

Job Description:

As an Acquisition Account Executive, you will be responsible for driving net-new customer acquisition within the mid-market segment (organisations typically under $1B in revenue)—the core of our business. This role is focused on creating pipeline, opening new accounts, and closing new business.

Success in this role requires the ability to generate demand, establish credibility quickly with new prospects, and guide customers through complex and often ambiguous buying processes. You will operate with a high degree of ownership over your territory, consistently building momentum through proactive prospecting and disciplined execution.

The ideal candidate thrives in early-stage sales, demonstrates resilience, curiosity, and urgency, and is energised by prospecting, competition, and solving hard problems. They are comfortable engaging senior decision-makers without prior relationships, leading with insightful discovery and value-based conversations, and turning skepticism into customer conviction.

What will I be doing:

New Business Acquisition & Territory Ownership

- Own and drive net-new logo acquisition across an assigned mid-market territory
- Proactively identify, prospect, and develop new business opportunities through outbound and inbound activity
- Take full accountability for pipeline creation, territory performance, and target attainment

Full-Cycle Sales Execution

- Manage the entire sales cycle (360°) from prospecting through close
- Lead discovery conversations focused on customer risk, environment, and business priorities
- Tailor messaging and solutions based on customer needs and insights gathered
- Develop proposals, handle objections, negotiate effectively, and close new business

Pipeline Generation & Management

- Build and sustain a consistent, high-quality pipeline through disciplined prospecting
- Maintain strong pipeline coverage while actively progressing deals
- Apply rigorous qualification standards and protect deal quality and pricing integrity
- Maintain accurate forecasting, reporting, and CRM hygiene

Customer Engagement & Value Selling

- Engage senior stakeholders (e.g., CISOs, CIOs, IT leaders) with credibility and clarity from first interaction
- Translate complex technical concepts into clear business value and outcomes
- Position solutions within the customer’s environment and competitive landscape
- Build trust quickly through strong communication, curiosity-led discovery, and practical insights

Proof of Value (POV) & Deal Progression

- Define clear success criteria tied to customer outcomes before POVs
- Lead POVs and demonstrations as decision-driving milestones, not just technical exercises
- Maintain momentum across long or non-linear buying cycles, driving toward clear decisions

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner closely with SDRs, Marketing, Channel, and technical teams to generate and progress opportunities
- Collaborate with internal experts to deliver compelling demonstrations and technical validation
- Leverage events, partners, and creative outreach to expand reach into new accounts

- Experience selling into mid-market organisations (≤ $1B revenue) with an understanding of their buying dynamics and constraints
- Strong discovery and value-selling skills, with the ability to ask insightful questions, uncover customer priorities, and align solutions to business outcomes
- Ability to establish executive-level credibility early, communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Skilled in objection handling, negotiation, and navigating complex or ambiguous sales cycles with resilience and persistence
- Track record of operating in target-driven, high-growth environments, maintaining focus and momentum even in the face of rejection or long deal cycles
- Solid commercial judgment and discipline, including pipeline management, forecasting, and deal qualification
- Working knowledge of cybersecurity, SaaS, or technical solutions, with the ability to position offerings within a broader ecosystem

- Ensure reporting processes, controls, and metric governance frameworks meet public company standards, including auditability, transparency, and compliance requirements.

- Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, accountability, and data-driven decision-making.

- Significant leadership experience within Enterprise Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a related function, ideally at Director or VP level.

- Demonstrated experience owning and governing enterprise-wide business metrics within a SaaS or subscription-based business.

- Strong expertise in SaaS metrics, including ARR, ACV, Bookings, ATR, NRR, sales pipeline analytics, and marketing funnel performance.

- Proven track record developing and scaling enterprise reporting platforms, dashboards, embedded analytics, and self-service data products.

- Experience partnering with Data Engineering and Data Platform teams to establish effective enterprise data and analytics operating models.

- Strong understanding of CRM, ERP, and enterprise business systems.

- Experience presenting business performance insights to Executive Leadership Teams, Boards of Directors, and investors.

- Demonstrated experience building, managing, and developing teams of Analysts, BI professionals, and Analytics Engineers.

- Strong understanding of AI and agentic technologies, including practical application in analytics environments.

- Experience implementing AI-driven analytics workflows, automation capabilities, or production-grade AI agents.

- Experience applying Agile methodologies and SDLC principles to analytics, BI, or data product delivery.

- Experience with modern BI and visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
